title: Roof Drain Repair – Lagoon Complex

onscreen_lines.desc: Remove all rust and deteriorated coating from fourteen (14) existing roof drain bodies.
onscreen_lines.block: 1 Remove all rust and deteriorated coating from fourteen (14) existing roof drain bodies. 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Clean and prepare surfaces to ensure proper adhesion of protective materials.
onscreen_lines.block: 2 Clean and prepare surfaces to ensure proper adhesion of protective materials. 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Apply a rust-inhibiting coating suitable for cast iron (e.g., Dura Coat or approved equal) to the bottom portion of each drain body.
onscreen_lines.block: 3 Apply a rust-inhibiting coating suitable for cast iron (e.g., Dura Coat or approved equal) to the bottom portion of each drain body. 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Remove existing drain couplings and 90-degree fittings from fourteen (14) roof drains.
onscreen_lines.block: 4 Remove existing drain couplings and 90-degree fittings from fourteen (14) roof drains. 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Install new no-hub rubberized mechanical couplings.
onscreen_lines.block: 5 Install new no-hub rubberized mechanical couplings. 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Insulate drain connections, fittings and piping and tie into existing insulation (length of piping varies, NTE 6 ft.)
onscreen_lines.block: 6 Insulate drain connections, fittings and piping and tie into existing insulation (length of piping varies, NTE 6 ft.) 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Replace with new 90-degree street fittings (bends) and reconnect to existing drain lines.
onscreen_lines.block: 7 Replace with new 90-degree street fittings (bends) and reconnect to existing drain lines. 14 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Ensure all connections are secure, watertight, and properly aligned.
onscreen_lines.block: 8 Ensure all connections are secure, watertight, and properly aligned. 1 LS No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Evaluate existing piping materials for compatibility with new fittings and connections.
onscreen_lines.block: 9 Evaluate existing piping materials for compatibility with new fittings and connections. 1 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: Identify and report any additional deficiencies observed during the course of work.
onscreen_lines.block: 10 Identify and report any additional deficiencies observed during the course of work. 1 EA No Response
